prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1484; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter is to advise that our firm now represents the claimant in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at an intersection, and that all further communication regarding this matter should be directed exclusively to our office. Please do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the loss. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage may apply.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle inspection and repair records, telematics or event data recorder information, police and incident reports, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Preserving this material is essential to the fair resolution of our client's claim.

Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing within ten days, and direct your response to the undersigned counsel's office.
